# Changelog

All notable changes to THE RECORD Suite.

## [fix/release-script-and-package-cleanup] — 2026-06-17

### Fixed
- **Stale Package.swift product references** — `Record-App/Package.swift` referenced an `Infrastructure` product absent from `Record-Foundation`; removed so standalone package resolves cleanly (`10e8aaae9`)
- **release.sh rewrite** — BodyMan template had wrong `APP_NAME`, `BUNDLE_ID`, `VERSION`, and build path; rewrote to build `TheRecord` from repo-root `Package.swift`, copies `Info.plist`, and DMGs with correct signing identity (`10e8aaae9`)
- **Cmlx.framework embedding** — framework was not embedded in app bundle and inner frameworks were unsigned; release.sh now signs inner frameworks before the app (`a910d6de5`)
- **DuckDB PRAGMA user_version incompatibility** — DuckDB does not support SQLite's `PRAGMA user_version`; replaced with an explicit `schema_version` table; fixed startup crash: `Catalog Error: Pragma Function with name user_version does not exist!` (`62ed124f9`)
- **rowCount guard on first boot** — precondition crash when `schema_version` table is empty on fresh install; guarded in `DuckDBReaderActor`, `DuckDBMigrationRunner`, and `DuckDBWriterActor` (`77e957426`)

---

## [datum/bug-batch-31] — 2026-06-13

### Fixed

- bug-batch-31 Act phase — 6 fixes across security/logging/SSOT/UX lanes

### Other

- bug-batch-31 — 14 lanes, 15 open findings across 6 groups

---

## [Epic 30] — 2026-06-13 — Audit Remediation (Quality & Observability)

### Fixed
- **Test-only code cleanup** — removed `#if DEBUG` scaffolding and mock injection points from production AudioFileConverter
- **CachingContextProvider wiring** — connected DuckDB context cache to AppAssembler DI graph; MCP providers now support semantic caching with TTL-based eviction
- **Transcript privacy logging** — audit and fix all `os_log` calls to use `.private` privacy level when logging transcript content (T049)
- **Memory leak fixes** — stored Combine `.sink` cancellables in `Set<AnyCancellable>` to prevent unintended subscription retention
- **Dead code removal** — identified and removed unused functions, deprecated methods, and TODO-marked code blocks

### Added
- **Swiftlint enforcement** — added rules for `force_cast`, `force_try`, `implicitly_unwrapped_optional`, `unowned_variable_capture` to catch unsafe patterns early
- **Public API documentation** — added brief doc comments (`/// Summary.`) to key public interfaces in core layers

### Docs
- CHANGELOG entry documenting epic-30 audit remediation scope and fixes

### Test Coverage
- Root suite: baseline 816+ tests / 137+ suites / 0 failures maintained throughout remediation

---

## [Epic 28] — 2026-06-12 — AEC Completion (PR #187)

### Added
- **Echo cancellation toggle** — `AudioCaptureConfig.echoCancellationEnabled` (default `true`), surfaced in Settings → General; legacy configs without the field decode to `true` via `decodeIfPresent` (INV-001, COMPAT-001)
- **`CleanedAudioSink`** protocol (Domain) + **`CleanedAudioSinkMetadata`** — consumer-defined seam for post-AEC audio capture
- **`WAVCleanedAudioSink`** (Record-Audio Infrastructure) — writes `<session>-mic-cleaned.wav` (16kHz mono PCM) on its own dispatch queue; zero-append finalize yields a valid empty 44-byte WAV (BOUND-003); double finalize returns cached metadata (IDEM-002)
- **Session wiring** — toggle read once at stream start (ORD-002); AEC OFF means no processor invocation and no sink created (INV-004); sink frames are byte-identical to transcription frames (INV-002); sink failure can never fail the recording (SAFE-001); cleaned-mic path persisted only on successful non-empty finalize (SAFE-003)
- **DuckDB migration** — additive `cleaned_mic_audio_path` column via idempotent `ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS`
- **Verification lane** — AEC latency median 0.293ms/frame, p90 0.315ms vs 8ms budget (PERF-001); 84% echo-energy suppression vs 30% threshold with a pass-through control proving no fake pass
  - Re-measured 2026-07-02 during mega-remediation (branch `fix/mega-remediation-20260701`, after #244/#245 fixes): latency median 0.344ms/frame, p90 0.375ms — still well under the 8ms budget; echo-energy suppression 83.8% (ratio 0.162) vs the same 30% threshold. `AECProcessorActorTests` 19/19 pass.

### Fixed
- `.swiftlint.yml` had no `excluded:` section — swiftlint crawled `.build/checkouts` and `Prebuilts` (~14k phantom violations); `no_setenv` custom rule referenced by disable comments was never defined
- 15 real lint violations: 6 `for_where`, 9 cyclomatic-complexity refactors (behavior-preserving helper extractions in PipelineRunner, ResultPrinter, Compare, SchemaGenerator, DuckDBReaderActor, CoreAudioTapCaptureActor)

### Docs
- AGENTS.md: agent operations lessons (background-agent recovery, gh api over WebFetch, bulk-edit guardrails, stale SourceKit diagnostics) + sub-package test gotcha (root `swift test --filter` silently matches 0 tests for Record-Audio/Record-ML suites)

### Test Coverage
- `WAVCleanedAudioSinkTests` (5), `RecordingStateAECToggleTests` (5), `SettingsViewModelEchoCancellationTests`, `EchoCancellationConfigTests`, AEC bypass/latency/echo-reduction tests
- Root suite **792/792**; review verdict APPROVE, all 28 properties PASS

---

## [Epic 21] — 2026-05-26 — Acoustic Text Scrubbing (PR #55)

### Added
- **Word-level timestamps** — `WordTimestamp` domain type (`Sendable, Codable, Equatable`); `TranscriptionSegment` and `DiarizedSegment` gain `wordTimings: [WordTimestamp]?`
- **`WhisperKitProPlugin`** (Record-Pro) — passes `DecodingOptions(wordTimestamps: true)` to WhisperKit; maps `WordTiming → WordTimestamp` with probability clamped to [0, 1]
- **`DTWWordAligner`** (Record-Pro) — DTW forced alignment blending per-frame RMS audio energy with uniform text prior; INV-001..INV-004 enforced; 10s timeout (SAFE-002)
- **`AlignTranscriptUseCase`** (Record-Pro) — background actor that loads audio, skips already-aligned segments (IDEM-001), runs DTW, persists via `WordTimingsWriteRepository`; fire-and-forget, errors swallowed (SAFE-001)
- **`AlignmentUseCase`** protocol + **`WordTimingsWriteRepository`** protocol (Domain)
